llm_instructions.writing_guide:
Kling v2 has a dedicated camera_control parameter — use it instead of describing camera movement in the text field. Set camera_control to the appropriate value from the options list, then do NOT describe that same movement in the text prompt (it causes conflicts).

In the text prompt, focus on: subject appearance and action, environment, lighting, and visual style. The camera is handled by camera_control.

Negative prompts are supported and effective. Include quality terms: blur, distortion, artifacts, low quality.

Mode: use 'standard' for most shots. Use 'pro' for hero shots, establishing shots, or anything that will be prominent in the final cut.

Duration: 5s is the standard unit. 10s for slow establishes or extended action.

Kling v2 responds very well to reference images. Use the image BONE output as the start frame whenever available — the resulting video will be significantly more consistent with the intended frame.

Keep text prompts under 150 words. Avoid camera language in the text field since camera_control handles it.
